method: Deterministic nearest-neighbour resizing and exact source-palette hair recoloring of original project-authored crowd concept frames from batches v1-v3.
sourceRights: All source pixels came from locally authored, project-owned concept batches. No supplied ZIP, internet asset, external raster, or model output was used.

ageMethod.child: 20x27 nearest-neighbour source frame anchored on the common ground pivot; non-professional participation only.
ageMethod.teen: 22x29 nearest-neighbour source frame anchored on the common ground pivot; age band is 16-19 and employment roles are not represented at this stage.
ageMethod.elder: Exact source frame with exact palette hair pixels changed to silver; mobility cues remain role-specific and are not universalized.
